palette.aliasNote: Legacy blue/orange names now map to forest green; Tailwind blue-soft differs from CSS --blue-soft. Read exact source tokens when editing.

typography.headings: H1/H2 balanced, tracking -0.025em, default line-height 1.06; sage italic emphasis
typography.sectionH2: clamp(38px, 4vw, 55px); 40px at <=767px for primary section headings
typography.bodyScale: Section copy 13–14px with 1.8–1.9 line-height; desktop hero copy 16px; labels and captions 10–12px; tabular calculator numerals

layout.container: CSS width min(100%, 1360px), centered; horizontal padding 48px, 32px at <=1100px, 22px at <=767px
layout.tailwindContainer: Config separately declares 2xl 1680px and 1.25/1.5/2rem padding; studio container rules in globals.css set the visual width/padding
layout.header: Sticky top 0, z-index 50, solid ivory and 1px bottom rule; nav height 92/80/76px for desktop/tablet/mobile
layout.hero: Desktop columns 1.14fr 1fr, gap 38px; one column and 34px gap on mobile
layout.sections: 110px vertical spacing, 65px mobile; method 95/60px, calculator 90/60px, closing CTA 85/60px
layout.patterns: Ruled service/use-case rows; three-column method; two-column knowledge, skills, calculator and FAQ; single-column mobile; reading article capped at 850px
layout.surfaces: Square primary buttons and contact controls; flat ivory/sage/sand bands; 1px rules; retained shared reading surfaces use 4px corners and remove card shadows/gradients

motion.artwork: 1s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) clip-path reveal from inset(0 0 7% 0) to inset(0)
motion.controls: 0.2s background/transform transitions; primary hover lifts 2px; open accordion plus rotates 45deg; insight arrow shifts 3px right and up
motion.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables all animations/transitions and switches scroll behavior to auto

interaction.focus: 2px solid #8d542f outline with 5px offset; visible skip link targets focusable #main-content
interaction.navigation: Desktop current-page underline; 44px mobile menu button with aria-expanded/aria-controls; Escape closes and restores toggle focus; links close menu
interaction.accordions: Native details/summary with decorative plus icon
interaction.calculator: Labeled native range inputs, output values, polite live result; people 1–25, hours 0–20, rate EUR25–150 step 5
interaction.form: Labeled required name/email/question; native email validation; submit disabled with busy text while sending; polite success, assertive error
interaction.consent: Fixed bottom-left notice with accept/refuse; analytics requires consent; footer reopens preferences
